title: 복습 E: 콧소리·흐름소리·된소리 되기
objective: Read 한국말, 설날 and 학교 with their real sounds.
summary: Consonants change sound next to each other.

task.title: Read and write real sounds
task.line: Say each word out loud, then write or choose how it really sounds.

words.exampleMeaning: I see my family on Lunar New Year's Day.

letters.as: Before ㄴ/ㅁ, the stop sound turns into a nasal sound: k→ng, t→n, p→m.
Both become l, like the 'l l' across 'all lemons'.
The second sound gets tight with no puff of air, like 'k' in 'sky'.

exercises: Write the real sound in [ ] (stop + ㄴ/ㅁ): ① 국민 ② 십만 ③ 박물관
Write the real sound in [ ] (ㄴ and ㄹ together): ① 한라산 ② 물냉면 ③ 난로
Choose the right sound: ① 입구 [입꾸 / 임구] ② 국물 [국물 / 궁물] ③ 숙제 [숙제 / 숙쩨]
Which rule changes the sound? Write A (nasal sound), B (ㄹ sound [ㄹㄹ]) or C (tense sound): ① 입니다 ② 책상 ③ 신라
answers: ① A [임니다] ② C [책쌍] ③ B [실라]
